title: Brownfield: link expiry + inflated click analytics bug
requirement: Product and marketing feedback on the existing URL shortener. (1) Campaign links must be able to expire: allow an optional expiry when creating a link; expired links must stop redirecting and return 410 Gone, and the expiry must be visible in link metadata. (2) Bug: click analytics are inflated. Link-preview bots (Slackbot, Twitterbot, facebookexternalhit, etc.) and HEAD requests are counted as human clicks. Bot traffic should remain visible but be excluded from total_clicks. Existing API clients must keep working.
context: Existing production service in service/ (ASP.NET Core minimal APIs + SQLite). Live databases must upgrade in place.

approval_script.comment: Additive nullable column + defaulted flag; no table rewrite. Approved.

faults.why: exhausts the retry budget so the engine switches to the fallback agent
